title: Enhanced Accumulation of Cisplatin in Ovarian Cancer Cells from Combination with Wedelolactone and Resulting Inhibition of Multiple Epigenetic Drivers.
authors: Sarwar, Sadia; Alamro, Abir A; Alghamdi, Amani A; Naeem, Komal; Ullah, Salamat; Arif, Muazzam; Yu, Jun Qing; Huq, Fazlul
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蟛蜞菊内酯与顺铂联用对卵巢癌耐药细胞的影响，虽涉及铂-DNA结合和分子对接，但核心是药物增敏与表观遗传靶点，非TF-DNA互作建模，方法浅层且无AI/物理模拟创新。
abstract: PURPOSE: Cisplatin resistance is a major concern in ovarian cancer treatment. The aim of this study was to investigate if wedelolactone could perform better in resistant ovarian cancer cells when used in combination with cisplatin. METHODS: Growth inhibitory potential of wedelolactone and cisplatin was investigated through MTT reduction assay in ovarian cancer cell lines including A2780 (sensitive), A2780(cisR) (cisplatin resistant) and A2780(ZD0473R.) Resistance factor (RF) of drugs was determined in these three cell lines. Combination index (CI) was calculated as a measure of combined drug action. Effect of this combination on changes in the cellular accumulation of platinum levels and platinum-DNA binding was also determined in vitro using AutoDock Vina while the effect of wedelolactone on inhibition of possible key culprits of resistance including Chk1, CD73, AT tip60, Nrf2, Brd1, PCAF, IGF1, mTOR1 and HIF2alpha was investigated in silico. RESULTS: Cisplatin and wedelolactone showed a dose-dependent growth inhibitory effect. RF value of wedelolactone was 1.1 in the case of A2780(cisR) showing its potential to bring more cell death in cisplatin-resistant cells. CI values were found to vary showing antagonistic to additive outcomes. Additive effect was observed for all sequences of administration (0/0, 0/4 and 4/0 h) in A2780(cisR). Enhanced cellular accumulation of cisplatin was observed in parent and resistant cells on combination. Docking results revealed that among the selected oncotargets, Chk1, CD73, Nrf2, PCAF and AT tip60 were more vulnerable to wedelolactone than their respective standard inhibitors. CONCLUSION: These findings have shown that additive outcome of drug combination in A2780(cisR) and raised levels of platinum accumulation followed a clear pattern. This observation indicates that the presence of wedelolactone might have contributed to sensitize A2780(cisR). However, in silico results point to the possible effects of this compound on epigenetic factors involving tumor microenvironment, epithelial mesenchymal transition, and immune-checkpoint kinases.
abstract_zh: 目的：顺铂耐药是卵巢癌治疗中的一个主要问题。本研究旨在探讨蟛蜞菊内酯（wedelolactone）与顺铂联合使用时，是否能在耐药卵巢癌细胞中表现更佳。方法：通过MTT还原实验，在卵巢癌细胞系A2780（敏感型）、A2780(cisR)（顺铂耐药型）和A2780(ZD0473R)中研究了蟛蜞菊内酯和顺铂的生长抑制潜力。测定了这三种细胞系中药物的耐药因子（RF）。计算联合指数（CI）作为联合药物作用的度量。还通过AutoDock Vina在体外测定了该联合用药对细胞铂水平积累和铂-DNA结合变化的影响，同时通过计算机模拟研究了蟛蜞菊内酯对耐药可能关键因素（包括Chk1、CD73、AT tip60、Nrf2、Brd1、PCAF、IGF1、mTOR1和HIF2alpha）的抑制作用。结果：顺铂和蟛蜞菊内酯表现出剂量依赖性的生长抑制效应。在A2780(cisR)中，蟛蜞菊内酯的RF值为1.1，表明其在顺铂耐药细胞中具有促进更多细胞死亡的潜力。CI值显示结果从拮抗到加性不等。在A2780(cisR)中，所有给药顺序（0/0、0/4和4/0小时）均观察到加性效应。联合用药后，亲本细胞和耐药细胞中顺铂的细胞积累均增强。对接结果显示，在选定的肿瘤靶点中，Chk1、CD73、Nrf2、PCAF和AT tip60对蟛蜞菊内酯的敏感性高于其各自的标准抑制剂。结论：这些发现表明，在A2780(cisR)中药物联合的加性结果以及铂积累水平的升高遵循了明确的模式。这一观察结果表明，蟛蜞菊内酯的存在可能有助于使A2780(cisR)敏感化。然而，计算机模拟结果指出了该化合物对涉及肿瘤微环境、上皮间质转化和免疫检查点激酶的表观遗传因素可能产生的影响。
